title: One-time API token dismissal focus recovery
classification: Confirmed keyboard focus loss in the current account token panel.

finding.trigger: After a token is created, keyboard focus can be on Done while the one-time secret is visible.
finding.before: Done removed itself with the secret panel, leaving focus without an intentional target.
finding.expected: Clear the secret and keep keyboard focus within the account panel at the next relevant control.

change.summary: Done now clears the secret and returns focus to the token-name field.
change.regression_test: frontend/shared/src/account/TokensPanel.test.tsx creates a synthetic token, activates Done, and checks both secret removal and focus restoration.

limits: The test uses mocked token API calls and does not replace the R1972 exact-image replay.
Screen-reader and real-browser keyboard review remain open.
